description: Angular component for managing requirements with CRUD operations, inline editing, and filtering.

classes.name: RequirementsComponent
classes.description: Angular component providing a UI for requirements management with add, edit, delete, and filter functionalities.

methods.name: hasUnsavedChanges
methods.description: Checks for unsaved changes in add or edit forms.

methods.name: filtered
methods.description: Computed property filtering requirements based on search query.

methods.name: startAdd
methods.description: Initializes the form for adding a new requirement.

methods.name: confirmAdd
methods.description: Adds a new requirement if the title is valid.

methods.name: saveEdit
methods.description: Saves changes to an existing requirement.

methods.name: statusClass
methods.description: Returns CSS classes based on requirement status.
